incidents.title: Checkout latency and errors during payment submit
incidents.customer_impact: 23 percent of checkout attempts exceeded 3 seconds; 4.8 percent returned HTTP 503.
symptoms: payments saw elevated upstream timeout errors
incidents.expected_root_cause: checkout latency was caused by postgres connection exhaustion after checkout deployed a database pool max_open_connections change from 20 to 80.

incidents.title: Payment authorization failures after gateway timeout change
incidents.customer_impact: Some card authorizations failed for 18 minutes; retries usually succeeded.
incidents.expected_root_cause: payments reduced the external gateway timeout to 500 ms, causing legitimate gateway responses to time out.

incidents.title: Frontend product page error spike after cache purge
incidents.customer_impact: Product detail pages intermittently returned HTTP 500 while caches warmed.
symptoms: frontend product route HTTP 500 rate increased
incidents.expected_root_cause: a frontend cache purge exposed a missing fallback for product metadata cache misses.
